html:
Robinson Island Nha Trang, a hidden gem tucked away in the Bich Dam Strait, is quickly becoming an ideal destination for travelers seeking tranquility and untouched natural beauty. With powdery white sand beaches, crystal-clear turquoise waters, and a rich marine ecosystem, this small island promises unforgettable experiences for visitors in the summer of 2026.

Located approximately 10 kilometers from Cau Da Tourist Port, Robinson Island offers a peaceful escape from the bustling city. Surrounded by the vast blue ocean, the island feels completely secluded, allowing travelers to immerse themselves in pristine nature and slow-paced island life.

The moment you arrive, you will sense the calm atmosphere as gentle waves lap against the shore. As the sun sets, gathering around a beach bonfire with friends and fellow travelers creates memorable moments where stress and worries simply fade away. Robinson Island is not only visually stunning but also filled with exciting activities, making it a perfect addition to any Nha Trang travel itinerary.

What Makes Robinson Island Nha Trang Special?

Robinson Island is more than just a beautiful island; it is an ideal destination for both relaxation and adventure. Thanks to its prime location and diverse ecosystem, the island offers unique experiences rarely found elsewhere.

Unlike heavily commercialized islands, Robinson Island retains its raw, untouched charm. It is part of the Nha Phu Bay area one of the most beautiful bays in Khanh Hoa Province known for its biodiversity and scenic landscapes. Visitors can admire unspoiled beaches, explore colorful coral reefs, and gain insight into the daily life of local fishing communities.

Often referred to as a “mini Maldives of Vietnam,” Robinson Island has no luxury resorts or noisy entertainment complexes. Instead, it offers coconut-lined beaches, dramatic rock formations, and emerald-green seawater perfect for photography lovers and travelers seeking true peace and simplicity.

Best Time To Visit Robinson Island

Nha Trang enjoys warm and sunny weather year-round, but the best time to explore Robinson Island is from March to September.

  • March to September: Dry season, calm seas, clear skies ideal for swimming, snorkeling, kayaking, and island exploration.

  • June to August: Peak summer months with vibrant marine colors and excellent visibility underwater.

  • March and September: Fewer crowds, more peaceful atmosphere.

It is advisable to avoid the rainy season from October to December, as rough seas and heavy rain may affect transportation and activities.

How To Get To Robinson Island Nha Trang

Travelers can reach Robinson Island using several transportation options:

Speedboat

The fastest and most convenient option, departing from Cau Da Port. Travel time is approximately 45–60 minutes.
Price: Around 150,000 – 250,000 VND per person (one way).

Tourist Boat

Many tour operators offer daily boat tours that include meals and activities. This option is convenient and cost-effective for first-time visitors.

Private Boat Rental

Ideal for families or groups seeking privacy and flexible schedules. While more expensive, it offers comfort and customization.

Basket Boat Or Canoe

For adventurous travelers who want a closer connection to local fishing life, small boats from nearby fishing villages can be arranged for short-distance trips.

Robinson Island is often combined with nearby attractions such as Monkey Island or Hon Lao, making group tours a popular and economical choice.

Top Things To Do On Robinson Island

Kayaking And Exploring Fishing Villages

Kayaking is one of the most popular activities on the island. Paddle through clear waters, glide past rocky cliffs, and explore hidden corners of the coastline. Visitors can also visit nearby fishing villages to learn about traditional livelihoods and enjoy freshly caught seafood.

Swimming And Relaxing On White Sandy Beaches

Robinson Island boasts long stretches of soft white sand and calm, shallow waters perfect for swimming and sunbathing. Beach chairs and umbrellas are available in some areas, making it easy to relax and unwind.

Snorkeling And Coral Watching

The island’s marine ecosystem is rich and well-preserved. Snorkeling and diving allow visitors to explore vibrant coral reefs and colorful tropical fish. Equipment and professional guides are available, making this activity suitable even for beginners.

Beach Camping And Bonfire Nights

For nature lovers, overnight beach camping is an unforgettable experience. Sleep under a sky full of stars, enjoy a seafood barbecue, and wake up to a stunning sunrise over the sea. Evening bonfires add warmth, fun, and a sense of connection among travelers.

Exploring The Island’s Natural Ecosystem

Beyond the beach, Robinson Island features small forest trails, coconut groves, and mangrove areas. Walking through these paths offers opportunities to observe seabirds, native plants, and the island’s natural biodiversity.

Enjoy Fresh Seafood On Robinson Island

No island trip is complete without seafood. Robinson Island offers a variety of freshly caught seafood such as oysters, scallops, squid, shrimp, crabs, and fish. These dishes are often simply prepared to preserve their natural flavors.

Popular specialties include grilled lobster, steamed crab with beer, chili-garlic snails, and Nha Trang’s famous fish salad. Beachside BBQ dinners at sunset are a highlight, creating a memorable dining experience by the sea.

Estimated Travel Costs To Robinson Island

  • Transportation:
    Round-trip speedboat: 300,000 – 500,000 VND per person
    Private boat rental: 1,500,000 – 3,000,000 VND per boat

  • Food:
    Seafood meals: 200,000 – 500,000 VND per person

  • Activities:
    Kayaking: 100,000 – 150,000 VND per hour
    Snorkeling/Diving: 500,000 – 1,000,000 VND per session
    Camping tent rental: 150,000 – 300,000 VND per night

  • Accommodation:
    Homestays: 300,000 – 700,000 VND per night

A 2-day, 1-night trip typically costs 1,500,000 – 3,000,000 VND per person, depending on travel style and activities.

Important Tips For Visiting Robinson Island

  • Book services in advance during peak season

  • Bring sunscreen, swimwear, insect repellent, and personal medication

  • Carry cash, as electronic payments may be limited

  • Respect nature: do not litter or damage coral reefs

  • Follow safety instructions for water activities

  • Expect limited internet access embrace a digital detox

  • Engage with local communities to learn about island culture

Final Thoughts

Robinson Island Nha Trang is a perfect destination for travelers seeking serenity, natural beauty, and authentic island experiences. Whether you want to relax on untouched beaches, explore vibrant coral reefs, or enjoy peaceful nights by the sea, Robinson Island offers it all.

If you are planning a trip to Nha Trang and looking for a quiet escape away from the crowds, Robinson Island is an excellent choice one that will leave you with unforgettable memories of Vietnam’s coastal beauty.
